title: Every quantum system is conscious, no classical system is

statements.text: Since a pattern of phase-locked field modes fixes both the physical and the phenomenal properties of a quantum system, every quantum system is expected to be conscious, simple ones such as atoms rudimentarily and coherent cell assemblies richly. Classical systems leave the field unaffected and cannot be conscious, so the formation of coherent attractors is the dividing line.
